description: We are seeking an accomplished and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This is a highly confidential search for a leader who is passionate about driving census growth and enhancing community presence. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in shaping the facility's market strategy and achieving ambitious goals.This role offers a significant opportunity for an experienced professional who is ready to make a substantial impact. We are looking for a proactive and results-driven individual with a professional demeanor, capable of navigating a competitive market. The position requires flexibility, including occasional weekend work, and offers excellent compensation for the right candidate who can demonstrate a strong track record of success.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, ideally within a skilled nursing or healthcare environment.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute effective marketing strategies to drive census.
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills with a professional and presentable demeanor.
Highly motivated, proactive, and results-oriented with a strong drive to succeed.
Flexibility to work occasional weekends as business needs dictate.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.
